name: C1-different-files
description: Plan 8.4 C1: N agents each write to their own file, 50 small writes per agent, 10 writes per second per agent. Run with --agents 1, 5, 10 and 20 and compare the p95 of the write step. Pass when throughput scales to 20 agents with p95 under 1.2 s and no climit queue errors. Agent i writes to agentFileIds[i] from the setup vars file.
